verdicts.why: Wiki: Fury rose to Colonel in the U.S. Army, then left for the CIA, then joined S.H.I.E.L.D., all before 1995; in Captain Marvel he is already a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent, so Army and CIA are backstory. The repeated S.H.I.E.L.D. stage at Iron Man adds nothing.

Secret Invasion ep. 2: Rhodes (Raava) tells Fury he is being fired by the U.S. government (wiki: 'lose his position when he was fired'); in the finale he leaves with Varra to return to S.A.B.E.R. ('Return to S.A.B.E.R.'). The combined list with the B fix is right.

Age of Ultron: the Hulk takes the Quinjet, cuts off communication so the team cannot track him, and leaves Earth (he quits the team). Brand New Day: by 2028 he is an Empire State University professor (ESU is a group the dataset uses, and this record already tracks Culver University), and after the rampage he is 'promptly removed from his position at Empire State University' (fired).
Yinsen is a hostage of the Ten Rings. Being captured and held is not a move under the owner's rules, so 'Independent (from the start)' stands.

The Ten Rings stage is captivity, which is not a move, so I dropped it. The S.H.I.E.L.D. join holds: at the end of Iron Man 2 Tony 'took the job as consultant' (wiki 'Consultant for S.H.I.E.L.D.'; infobox lists S.H.I.E.L.D. as a former affiliation).
Rhodes was kidnapped by the Skrull Resistance and held in a Fracking Pod. That is captivity, not a move, so the record stands as it is.

The Endgame rejoin is clear: Rocket and Banner 'recruit Thor back to the Avengers' and he agrees. The Age of Ultron exit is unsure, because he tells Stark and Rogers 'he would eventually return'. The Asgard re-entry before Sakaar is a homecoming, not a group change. I left both of those as they were.

Wiki 'Assisting the Avengers' (cited to Age of Ultron): 'Selvig was recruited by the Avengers' and moved to the Avengers Compound as one of its key consultants. That is a join, and it is on a title he is on file for.

Darcy was brought in by S.W.O.R.D. for the Westview case; after Wanda's confrontation, Hayward has her, Woo and Rambeau 'ordered to leave the Response Base' ('Ejected from the Base'). She then works against S.W.O.R.D. and is handcuffed and abandoned by its agents. Her S.W.O.R.D. role ends inside WandaVision.

This record's first title is Thor: The Dark World, which opens with Loki already imprisoned after the Battle of New York. His Chitauri alliance comes before that, and the stage uses a title (The Avengers) the record has no step for.

Ragnarok: on Sakaar Loki 'gained his favor', is the Grandmaster's friend, and takes his commission to bring back Thor and Hulk. He later admits 'I've run out of favor with the Grandmaster' and betrays him. Sakaar is the group the Thor and Banner records use. The list is cumulative with the B fix.

Wiki: 'Laura decided to retire from S.H.I.E.L.D.' and Fury erased her from the files and set up the Iowa farm, all before Age of Ultron, her first title. In Hawkeye she only gets her old watch back. That leaves one group, so '(from the start)' applies.

VisionQuest ep. 1 ('No Strings'): Paladin's mercenaries attack The Old Selkie, killing owner Fiona Guthrie and 'forcing him to flee'. Later episodes have him on the run with Tommy (Saint Mabyn's, the Markridge gala, Madripoor), and he never returns to the pub.

In Vol. 2 his clan mutinies under Taserface, and he escapes with Rocket and Groot and joins the Guardians against Ego (wiki 'Joining the Guardians of the Galaxy'; infobox: Ravagers formerly, Guardians of the Galaxy current). The first stage is correctly on his first title on file.

Her first title on file is Vol. 2, where she is already out from under Ronan and Thanos and sets out to kill Thanos. The two stages at 'Guardians of the Galaxy' use a title the record has no step for and are backstory.

In The Marvels, Carol, Monica and Kamala team up as the Marvels (wiki 'Team Bonding'; infobox: Marvels formerly). The Aladnean marriage is current per the infobox and is shown on Aladna after the team forms, so Aladna stays last.

Hayward 'ordered her, Jimmy Woo, and Lewis off the base' (wiki: 'kicked off the base'). She then works against S.W.O.R.D. and is recruited from outside it by Fury's Skrull ('He heard you've been grounded'). The infobox lists S.W.O.R.D. as former.
Trevor is kidnapped and kept as Wenwu's prisoner. That is captivity, not membership, and escaping it is not a move under the owner's rules (his infobox has no Ten Rings affiliation).

value: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
verdicts.why: The Air Force stage at The Winter Soldier is backstory (he is a VA counselor there), and in FATWS, 'with the Avengers disbanded, Wilson returned to working with the United States Air Force' (infobox: USAF current). The Brave New World stage does not hold: Sam only 'decided to rebuild the Avengers', and the team is not yet formed, so I dropped it.

Wiki 'Leaving S.H.I.E.L.D.': after the dismantling, 'she joined the CIA', proving her marksmanship at the Langley range (cited to The Winter Soldier). By Civil War she is already a CIA agent stationed in Berlin, so the join belongs at The Winter Soldier.

The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
verdicts.why: The record is wrong: through FATWS she is a fugitive and crime boss, and only in the finale is she pardoned and given 'an opening in her old division, the CIA, which she accepted'. 'The Power Broker' is not a group name in the dataset (Nagel's record uses HYDRA and CIA) or in the source, so I used Independent and then the CIA rejoin.
Zemo's only title on file is FATWS, where he is a prisoner who is broken out and then sent to the Raft. EKO Scorpion is a former affiliation that ended before Civil War, and he never resumes it.

Wiki: after the USSR dissolved in December 1991 he 'found himself no longer operating' as Red Guardian, and in 1992 Dreykov sent him undercover to Ohio. Black Widow opens in 1995 with him already on that Red Room mission, so his Soviet Armed Forces service is backstory.

Wakanda Forever: CIA Director de Fontaine places Ross under arrest for treason, and Okoye frees him from the FBI transport, so he is a fugitive who has broken with the CIA (wiki: 'former CIA special officer'; CIA formerly). His Secret Invasion captivity is not a move.
